list: Official PS5 trophy list as published on PlayStation Network, taken 18 November 2026 from Exophase and cross-checked with PSNProfiles and TrueAchievements: 55 trophies — 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze, 28 hidden. The same 55 exist as Xbox achievements worth 1,000 Gamerscore.

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops on its own. There is no shortcut: finish the story, work the 100% checklist, finish the stranger strands, then clean up collectibles and activities. PowerPyx rates the whole set 4/10 in difficulty and about 200 hours, in a single playthrough, with no online trophies. Follow this guide's roadmap in order and it falls last.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (difficulty, time)

trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It is the first mission of the story and cannot be missed — play through it and the trophy pops at the end. This is the first of 12 story trophies, all hidden, all unmissable.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (12 story trophies, none missable)

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1. Story trophies cannot be missed, but do the Chapter 1 meditation for Positive Mental Attitude BEFORE the chapter ends: after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning, follow her to the balcony and choose Accept. That meditation is the one trophy in the game reported as missable, and there is no mission replay.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (Chapter 1 meditation)

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 2. Chapter 2 is where both protagonists become playable, which opens up the partner trophies (Hot Together, Retail Therapy) and most of the side activities — do those as they appear rather than leaving them all for after the story.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 3. Like the other chapter trophies it unlocks automatically at the chapter's end and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 4. The last chapter before the finale — keep a manual save at the start of the chapter, since the game has no mission replay and no New Game Plus.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (no mission replay)

trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission in Chapter 5. It is the gold story trophy and unlocks automatically. Before you start it, make a manual save: there is no mission replay, and after the story you return to free-roam where everything needed for the 100% checklist is still reachable.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (free-roam after the story)

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. Named-mission trophies unlock automatically when the mission ends and cannot be missed — just play the story through.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. It unlocks automatically at the end of the mission and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. It unlocks automatically at the end of the mission and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. It unlocks automatically at the end of the mission and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown at Vice City International Airport. It unlocks automatically at the end of the mission and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. It unlocks automatically at the end of the mission and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the in-game completion checklist, which opens after the story under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion. PowerPyx calls it the hardest trophy, but the thresholds are lenient — it is closer to 60% true completion. You only need 70 of the 80 Challenges, and most side quests are not required at all. The tasks that DO need everything are Robberies, Underwater Discoveries, Shooting Ranges, Drone Races and Bret's Quests. You only need to scan 200 of 277 base-model vehicles and study 100 of 255 animals through the binoculars. Work on it after the story: everything it needs is still reachable in free-roam.
trophies.name: A Long Road

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (100% checklist details)

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts of any kind across Leonida — stunt jumps, flights under bridges, knife flights and base jumps all count. PowerPyx counts 397 stunts in total, and the 100% checklist needs 300 of them, so keep jumping after this trophy pops. Stunts are tracked in the game's stats, so you can check your count as you go.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (397 stunts counted)

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try every type of activity the game offers at least once — races, the shooting range, fishing, arcade games, bowling, meditation, drone races and the rest. The in-game Activities list shows which types you have tried, so open it and work down the ones still blank. One of each is enough; you do not need to finish or win them.
trophies.name: Master of None

sources.name: Our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges at the ranges across Leonida. Each challenge has its own gold time or score — replay a challenge as many times as you need, since the ranges stay open after the story. PowerPyx notes the gold medals are not too difficult; take a weapon you are comfortable with and learn each range's targets before going for gold.
trophies.name: The Shootist

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (shooting range golds)

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Drone races are one of the activity types — find the Top Fun spots around Leonida, enter a race at each and finish first. The 100% checklist also needs every drone race, so this trophy and that checklist move together.
trophies.name: Top Fun

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (drone races in the 100% checklist)

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — each distinct race counts once, so work through the race list rather than repeating one you like. Any race type counts: street, off-road, boat and air races are all on the map once you have found them.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

sources.name: Our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find the fishing spots around Leonida, take the challenge against Cal and out-fish him. Fishing is one of the activity types, so it also counts toward Master of None.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

sources.name: Our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.guide: Finish one full arcade game at an arcade in Leonida. Any arcade game counts — pick one, play it through to its end and the trophy pops. Arcades also count as one of the activity types for Master of None.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

sources.name: Our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's stranger mission strand to its final mission. Stranger strands appear as question-mark contacts around Leonida — take Andy's missions whenever they show up and the strand ends with a finale that pops this trophy. It is one of the 8 strands that also count toward Strangers & Freaks.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (stranger strands)

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's stranger mission strand to its final mission. Take Kenton's missions as they appear and the strand ends with a finale that pops this trophy. It is one of the 8 strands that also count toward Strangers & Freaks.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (stranger strands)

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's stranger mission strand to its final mission. Take Billy's missions as they appear and the strand ends with a finale that pops this trophy. It is one of the 8 strands that also count toward Strangers & Freaks.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (stranger strands)

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 full stranger mission strands — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone are five of them, with three more strangers to find around the state. Each strand ends in a finale with its own trophy. PowerPyx notes this trophy is NOT part of the 100% checklist, so it is a separate step after the story: work the map for stranger icons until all 8 strands are done.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (8 strands, not part of 100%)

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's stranger mission strand to its final mission. Take Randy's missions as they appear and the strand ends with a finale that pops this trophy. It is one of the 8 strands that also count toward Strangers & Freaks.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (stranger strands)

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's stranger mission strand to its final mission. Take Tyrone's missions as they appear and the strand ends with a finale that pops this trophy. It is one of the 8 strands that also count toward Strangers & Freaks.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (stranger strands)

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida. THIS IS THE ONE MISSABLE TROPHY: the first meditation is Lucia's on the balcony at Jason's house in Chapter 1. After the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning — she says she is going to meditate — follow her to the balcony and choose Accept. Do it before Chapter 1 ends; there is no mission replay, and the spot is reported to disappear once the chapter is over. The other 17 spots are found across the map in free-roam, so sweep them after the story.
trophies.missableNote: The Chapter 1 balcony meditation disappears after Chapter 1. Do it before the chapter ends — there is no mission replay.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (the one potentially missable trophy)

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret asks for. Bret's quests are one of the strands the 100% checklist needs in full, so find Bret, take his hunts and follow the trail to the unique animal. Use the binoculars to study animals as you go — studying 100 of 255 animals also counts toward 100%.
trophies.name: Fair Game

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (Bret's Quests in the 100% checklist)

trophies.guide: Complete 3 full collectible card sets. Cards are hidden across Leonida — pick them up as you explore and the sets fill in. You do not need every card in the game, only three complete sets, so focus on the sets you are closest to finishing.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

sources.name: Our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It — the in-game camera/app — at 100 different locations across Leonida. Open WAiNK at scenic spots, landmarks and viewpoints and the count rises. It is a long grind best done while exploring for The Goodtime State: every new area you visit is a chance to WAiNK somewhere new.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

sources.name: Our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the game's 80 Challenges. Challenges cover combat, driving, exploration and more, and the game tracks each one — pick the easy ones first. You need 70 of 80 for the 100% checklist, so this trophy pops on the way there.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (70 of 80 challenges for 100%)

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, raise your wanted level to 4 stars, then lose the cops and escape. Both protagonists must be together, so this opens up from Chapter 2. Get the heat in open country where you can break line of sight, then hide until the wanted level clears — your partner must still be with you when it clears.
trophies.name: Hot Together

sources.name: Our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row without ever losing your wanted level. The trick is the opposite of Hot Together: keep the heat alive between robberies. Rob a shop, drive straight to the next with the cops still chasing, rob it, and then the third — do not let the wanted level clear until all three are done. Pick three shops close together on the map.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

sources.name: Our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles. Driving or scanning a vehicle you have not seen before adds it to your collection — the game tracks discoveries in the stats. It overlaps with the 100% checklist, which needs 200 of 277 base-model vehicles scanned, so scan everything you pass while exploring and this pops early.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (scan 200 of 277 vehicles for 100%)

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during one single use of Combat Focus. Find a spot with at least 5 enemies grouped together — a gang hangout or a shootout — activate Combat Focus and drop all five before it ends. Thin groups will not do it: wait until five are in range, then trigger it.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

sources.name: Our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Leave Vice City International Airport in an unscheduled way — take a plane and depart without going through the normal channels. The exact method has not yet been pinned down in a guide we trust: PowerPyx lists this trophy's method as not yet known, so treat the description as the clue and check the cited guide for updates. Our own reading: get airside at VCIA, take an aircraft and leave — the trophy is about the departure, not the flight.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (method not yet known)

trophies.guide: Deal with Rhino tanks — the description's joke is the clue: get into trouble with the army's tanks and come out of it. The exact trigger has not yet been pinned down in a guide we trust: PowerPyx lists this trophy's method as not yet known. Our own reading: draw a Rhino's attention at high wanted levels and survive or destroy it. Check the cited guide for the confirmed method.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (method not yet known)

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected — no alarms, no witnesses calling the cops, no wanted level during the robbery. Go in quiet: case the store first, move when the staff are not watching, take the goods and leave before anyone raises the alarm. If you are spotted, leave and try again another day.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

sources.name: Our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one. Bank robberies are the bigger heists in the open world — plan each one, hit the vault, then lose the wanted level before the next. The 100% checklist also needs the robberies done in full, so these five count toward both.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (robberies in the 100% checklist)

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks drive set routes around Leonida — stop one, get the crew out of the way, crack it open and take the cash, then lose the wanted level. It is the classic GTA robbery, and the smallest of the four robbery trophies, so do it first to learn the pattern.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

sources.name: Our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. The map tracks which areas you have visited — drive, fly and sail into every corner of the state, including the islands and the far north. It pairs naturally with WAiNK It at 100 locations and discovering 100 vehicles: explore an area, WAiNK it, scan what you find.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

sources.name: Our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs in Leonida. Gangs run their own off-the-books operations around the state — find one per gang, hit it and get out. The game tracks which gangs you have hit, so check the stats to see which are left.
trophies.name: Pest Control

sources.name: Our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Have a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Find a beach bar on Ocean Drive, order a cocktail and enjoy the view — the trophy is about the moment, not a mission. The exact spot has not yet been pinned down in a guide we trust: PowerPyx lists this trophy's method as not yet known. Our own reading: any beachfront bar on Ocean Beach should do it; sit, order, wait for the toast.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (method not yet known)

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style — drive a car straight through the showroom glass, the way the old games taught us. The exact showroom has not yet been pinned down in a guide we trust: PowerPyx lists this trophy's method as not yet known. Our own reading: pick a showroom with a big glass front, get a car inside or line one up outside, and go through it.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (method not yet known)

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play bowling at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and follow through — finish a full game there. Bowling is one of the activity types, so it also counts toward Master of None. Any score counts; the trophy is for playing the game through, not for winning it.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

sources.name: Our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.guide: A partnership moment with mass appeal — something the two protagonists do together that the public notices. The exact trigger has not yet been pinned down in a guide we trust: PowerPyx lists this trophy's method as not yet known. Our own reading: it is a co-op moment with your partner, likely tied to doing something spectacular together in public. Check the cited guide for the confirmed method.
trophies.name: Personal Best

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (method not yet known)

trophies.guide: Make choices across the game — PlayStation tracks a count up to 500 for this trophy. Choices appear in missions, conversations and activities throughout the story and free-roam. There is nothing special to do: keep playing and choosing, and the count climbs. It pops when the count reaches its target.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (count to 500)

trophies.guide: Succeed on a second try — fail something once, then get it right the second time. The description is the whole clue: the trophy is about a second attempt that works. The exact event has not yet been pinned down in a guide we trust: PowerPyx lists this trophy's method as not yet known. Our own reading: fail a challenge or attempt once, then complete it on the very next try.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (method not yet known)

trophies.guide: Witness something strange in Leonida — a rare world event. The description is deliberately vague: these trophies usually pop when you stumble on something out of the ordinary while exploring. The exact event has not yet been pinned down in a guide we trust: PowerPyx lists this trophy's method as not yet known. Our own reading: explore off the beaten path, especially at night and in remote places, and the strange will find you.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (method not yet known)

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone over with a melee attack from a moving vehicle — a melee drive-by. Drive past a target at speed and swing a melee weapon from the vehicle. The exact setup has not yet been pinned down in a guide we trust: PowerPyx lists this trophy's method as not yet known. Our own reading: a slow drive-by past a pedestrian with a bat or similar weapon should do it.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (method not yet known)

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder a total of $250,000 in Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists — they cannot be spent as-is, so use your contacts to clean them. The count is cumulative across the whole game, so keep laundering after every big score and it adds up. It pairs with the robbery trophies: rob, launder, repeat.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

sources.name: Our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.guide: Spend a total of $100,000 across all shops in Leonida — weapons, clothes, food, car mods, anything sold in a shop counts. The count is cumulative, so normal spending across a playthrough gets you most of the way; top it up with a shopping spree at the end if you are short.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

sources.name: Our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties around Leonida. Garages are bought through the in-game property market — save up (robberies and laundering help) and buy each one as you find it. The map shows properties for sale, so sweep the state after the story.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

sources.name: Our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find vehicles around Leonida, open the Scooter Bros app on the in-game phone and register each one. It overlaps with discovering vehicles for Whip It Good — register the interesting ones as you find them and this pops on the way.
trophies.name: On the Spot

sources.name: Our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game
